_doc.about: latr's todo logic (latr web/src/lib/utils/todo.ts and the edits app-state.svelte.ts makes), generated from latr's own code. Run by shared/src/todos/todo.spec.ts and Android :core TodoFixturesTest.
_doc.todos: Every todo here, in and out, is `base` with the listed fields replaced. Times are epoch milliseconds; snoozeUntil and occurrence are local YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss read in `zone`.
_doc.read: readTodo(id, data, now): a stored doc as the apps read it; missing times read as `now`, malformed fields as latr reads them, and a snoozeUntil or occurrence not in the full local form as null.
_doc.fields: todoFields(todo): what a write stores, before the store adds serverModifiedAt.
_doc.filters: The lists a todo shows in at `now`; snoozed is derived from snoozeUntil and state.
_doc.keys: ownKey (position, else 13-digit modifiedAt + idKey) and activeKey (a snoozeUntil's time in front of ownKey).
_doc.sort: sortForFilter: Snoozed by snooze time, then every list by its key newest first, then id. `todos` are the ones the filter shows.
_doc.edits: text: withText; snooze: withSnoozed(todo, until, now); pin: withPinToggled; done: withDone(todo, now, newId), with `spawned` the next copy or null; reactivate: withReactivated; repeat: withRepeat(todo, draft, now); delete: withDeleted.

read.name: missing fields take defaults and now
latr's old SNOOZED state reads as active
an unknown state reads as active
a snoozeUntil without seconds is not read
an occurrence with a zone is not read
a malformed position orders by time
a malformed repeat is a one-off
text that isn't a string reads as empty
